frozen: 2026-11-01, owner decision of that date (ledgers/approvals.jsonl), before D2 starts. Frozen: the standoffs, the overrun margin and the exclusion radius. Not settled: whether the radius meets the owner's position-lost rule (position_lost_rule), and the crew distance, which is the agent's proposal.
status_note: Replaces evals/D3-standoffs.json, which stays as the record for the X500. The braking, overrun and carried-speed terms were measured on a simulated proxy of the X650 (src/banshee/sitl/x650_proxy.py). They are not flight measurements, and the proxy's thrust, drag and motor lag are estimated. D3 logs may replace these values only through a new dated owner decision.
aircraft: Holybro X650 ARF, about 4-5 kg at takeoff, 15-inch carbon props

at_2_5_m_s.reaction_label: estimated: 1.35 s worst case at 2.5 m/s
at_2_5_m_s.braking_label: measured on the proxy: 3.01-3.26 m net of 0.2 s of reaction, across H-02 and K-01 at 5 kg, 4 kg and low drag
at_2_5_m_s.position_error_label: estimated: 2 x the 1.0 m RMS bound of ET-D3-2

at_1_0_m_s.reaction_label: estimated: 1.35 s worst case at 1.0 m/s
at_1_0_m_s.braking_label: measured on the proxy: 0.90-1.04 m net of 0.2 s of reaction, across H-01 and K-02 at 5 kg
at_1_0_m_s.position_error_label: estimated: 2 x the 0.5 m RMS bound of ET-D5-1

position_lost_rule.rule: The owner's rule of 2026-11-01: the 150 m exclusion radius covers position-lost cases on its own.
position_lost_rule.status: NOT MET on the proxy above 10 m: reported to the owner with options under WO-022's stop condition. No value was adjusted to fit.
position_lost_rule.method: Measured on the proxy: position lost at about 32 m out (the 30 m flight box plus the 2 m position error), flying downwind at 2.5 m/s, at each row's height and wind. Reach is ground truth from Home to the end of the ground slide. The 5 s of operator delay is estimated, as wind x 5 s. Wind is uniform, and ground contact is not validated.
position_lost_rule.not_included: Wind shear: the limit is read on a handheld meter near the ground. A 1/7 power law from 1.5 m gives 1.15 to 1.31 times that wind, averaged over the descent (estimated).

crew_distance_label: estimated, and proposed by the agent; the owner has not named it. Ballistic with quadratic drag, 2-15 g tumbling fragments at up to 140 m/s, 25 m release height, still air: this supports tens of metres, not a bound. Crew upwind of the flight box, because a downwind fragment travels further (72 m at 5 m/s).
overrun_margin_note: The 8.7 m standoff, rounded up. Measured fence overrun on the proxy: 3.28-3.67 m in the runs used; 3.64 m at 5 kg in a further run (G-01).
reaction_note: At the nominal speed limit, as on the X500. The proxy flew 2.50-2.63 m/s at the trigger; at 2.6 m/s the standoff would be 8.8 m, still under the 9 m margin.
